request.text: We are a couple traveling with our two kids, aged six and nine for an easy five day break. Please keep every day gentle, with no starts before nine and one full rest afternoon in the middle. We need a family room with an elevator in the building and stroller friendly routes where possible. I am vegetarian and our youngest cannot eat eggs, so please favor restaurants with clear vegetarian menus. Keep the total budget under one thousand one hundred dollars, avoid long walks between stops, and also include the ferry ride across to Levis and a trip out to Montmorency Falls please.
